meta.title: Checkout Captcha for WooCommerce Demo
meta.description: A ready-to-use WooCommerce store preview with Checkout Captcha configured on checkout, account, login, registration, and password reset flows.
meta.author: Jamsheed KM

options.blogdescription: WooCommerce demo store secured with checkout CAPTCHA
options.woocommerce_checkout_privacy_policy_text: Demo note: This checkout uses Google reCAPTCHA v2 test keys, so Google always approves test-key verification. Use the CAPTCHA configuration page to add real reCAPTCHA v2 keys for blocking tests. Your personal data will be used to process your order, support your experience throughout this website, and for other purposes described in our privacy policy.
options.woocommerce_checkout_terms_and_condition: I have read and agree to the website terms and conditions. Demo note: reCAPTCHA test keys always validate.
